items.title: Oil prices hit $100 for the first time since May
items.description: The price of Brent crude rose more than 6% on Thursday as the war in the Middle East continues to escalate.

items.title: Saudis must recognise Israel for nuclear deal, says Trump
items.description: The US president says the landmark agreement to help Saudis develop nuclear energy is dependent on it joining the Abraham Accords.

items.title: France evacuates 20,000 as wildfires spread in south-west
items.description: Most of those evacuated were tourists from campsites around Arcachon Bay in France's Gironde region.

items.title: India activist ends hunger strike after 26 days
items.description: Sonam Wangchuk, a supporter of youth-led protesters demanding education reforms, says he wants to avert "possible violence".

items.title: Ukraine's ousted defence minister insists on being reinstated
items.description: Mykhailo Fedorov refuses President Zelensky's offer to accept an alternative post, as the battle of wills continues.

items.title: Yemen's Houthis attack Saudi tanker as US launches more Iran strikes
items.description: The Iran-backed group, which previously announced a "maritime embargo" against Saudi Arabia, also claims to have hit another vessel.

items.title: Teen jailed for exam cheating in Guinea dies after sickle cell complications, father says
items.description: Mamadou Djouma Bah, 17, was arrested and sentenced to prison for exam fraud earlier this month.

items.title: 'Let's enjoy the ride' says Elon Musk, as AI fears mount
items.description: Talking to The Economist, Musk said he doesn't care if people hate him and said he was not a racist.

items.title: Nicaragua's legislature debates barring opposition from elections
items.description: The move comes days after President Daniel Ortega demanded 'a wall, a blockade' against opposition parties.

items.title: Ex-governor convicted of murdering a pregnant student in Kenya
items.description: Okoth Obado was found guilty of killing Sharon Otieno with whom he had had an affair.

items.title: Blocked by censors, China's animal lovers take fight against abuse offline and overseas
items.description: The killing of a dog and her puppies in Guangdong has sparked outrage inside and outside the country.

items.title: South Korea woman acquitted of murdering newborn after hospital delivery
items.description: The woman, who had wanted to end her pregnancy at 36 weeks, gave birth to a baby who doctors later killed.
